definitions.explanation: The compass direction between south and west.

examples.japanese: {南西|なんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{南西|なんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧。
examples.english: Okinawa is located to the southwest of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{低気圧|ていきあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{南西|なんせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}して→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧おり、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: A low-pressure system is approaching from the southwest, and rain is expected tomorrow.

notes:
Composed of {南|なん} (south) + {西|せい} (west). One of the four intercardinal directions. In Japanese geography, the {南西諸島|なんせいしょとう} (Nansei Islands, also called the Ryukyu Islands) are the island chain stretching southwest from Kyushu, including Okinawa.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南西|なんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ — southwest wind
- {南西|なんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧ — to be located to the southwest
- {南西|なんせい}⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ — southwest direction
- {南西部|なんせいぶ} — southwestern part/region
- {南西諸島|なんせいしょとう} — Nansei Islands (Ryukyu archipelago)

- ⟦{南東|なんとう}→南東：30083_nantou⟧ — southeast
- ⟦{北西|ほくせい}→北西：30082_hokusei⟧ — northwest
